name: smwsprites-big-boo-boss
title: Big Boo Boss
description:
A custom sprite that's based on the original sprite. It circles around the screen and will trigger the settings once it has been defeated. Comes with:

-A normal Big Boo Boss config. (Triggers secret exit on extra bit)
-A Big Boo Boss config that changes into a door.

More details in the readme.
